objective: Measure the six previously unmeasured, locally accepted layer-64 rank-four down corrections separately so interactions in the adverse complete-panel result cannot hide an individual model-KLD improvement.
evidence_boundary: The 16 public 512-token documents are candidate-selection data. Expert 253 was measured previously and is excluded. A retained singleton or composition requires evaluation on a new document-disjoint BF16-reference tier.

selection_protocol.retention_rule: Retain a singleton only when candidate-minus-resident equal-document mean KLD is negative on both document groups. Rank retained singletons by the mean over all 16 documents.
selection_protocol.composition_boundary: A composition chosen from singleton results is another selection candidate and requires a new document-disjoint confirmation tier.
